components.name: Floating Tool Capsule

components.name: Selected Mark on Paper
components.description: Paper sheet with a selected text mark: 1.5px ink outline, rotate handle on a stem, plus a tinted fillable field.
components.html: Mario Rossi
components.css: .ds-paper { position: relative; width: 280px; height: 160px; background: #fff; box-shadow: var(--paper-shadow, 0 1px 2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.08), 0 6px 24px -6px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.16)); } .ds-field { position: absolute; left: 24px; top: 24px; width: 160px; height: 22px; border-radius: 2px; background: oklch(0.46 0.2 266 / 0.08); transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-field:hover { background: oklch(0.46 0.2 266 / 0.14); } .ds-mark { position: absolute; left: 80px; top: 104px; padding: 0 2px; font: 16px Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: #000; outline: 1.5px solid var(--ink, oklch(0.46 0.2 266)); } .ds-stem { position: absolute; top: -24px; left: 50%; width: 1px; height: 16px; background: var(--ink, oklch(0.46 0.2 266)); } .ds-rot { position: absolute; top: -32px; left: 50%; width: 12px; height: 12px; margin-left: -6px; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink, oklch(0.46 0.2 266)); border-radius: 9999px; background: #fff; box-sizing: border-box; cursor: grab; }

narrative.overview:
The document is the only thing at rest. A neutral desk-grey canvas holds white paper sheets that cast a soft, real shadow, and every control lives in a separate floating layer of translucent rounded capsules hovering above the work, the way Figma floats its tools over a design. There is no full-width header bar and no docked side panel framing the page; the window chrome is the canvas itself.

The floating layer is monochrome, set in the system font at macOS density (13px), so the controls read as instruments rather than decoration. One colour carries meaning: the blue of a ballpoint signature. It marks only what the user is acting on (selection, handles, the active tool, focus) and the one action that commits work (Save). Everything else is greys and alpha over grey.

Light and dark are equal citizens. In dark mode the canvas goes near-black, capsules become smoked glass, and the white sheets are dimmed slightly so they do not glow in a dark room; the paper stays paper.
keyCharacteristics: Desk-grey canvas, white paper sheets with layered ambient shadow.
Controls float in translucent glass capsules (blur 24px, 0.5px hairline edge, layered soft shadow), anchored to window corners and the bottom centre.
One accent, signature ink blue, rationed to selection, active state, focus and Save.
System font throughout, 13px base, medium weight for controls, tabular numbers for every count, size and angle.
Concentric rounding: 14px capsule, 4px padding, 10px buttons inside.
Motion is short and soft: things rise in with a slight blur and settle on a smooth-out curve.

rules.name: The One Pen Rule
rules.body: Signature Ink is reserved for selection, handles, the active tool, focus, drop targets and Save. If something is ink-coloured, the user is either touching it or about to commit it.

rules.name: The Alpha-Over-Grey Rule
rules.body: UI neutrals are black (light) or white (dark) at low alpha, not fixed greys, so hover and fill states read the same over canvas, glass or paper.

rules.name: The Native Density Rule
rules.body: The base is 13px, the macOS body size. Hierarchy comes from weight (400/500/600) and grey level, not from a size ramp.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that changes (zoom, size, angle, page index) uses tabular figures so controls never jitter.

rules.name: The Three Planes Rule
rules.body: Canvas, paper, float. A new surface joins one of the three planes and takes that plane's shadow; it does not invent a fourth.

rules.name: The Glass Needs a Floor Rule
rules.body: Translucent float material is for compact capsules. Surfaces that carry paragraphs or forms (the stamps panel) use the 95% solid panel material so text reads as one tone over paper or canvas; under prefers-reduced-transparency capsules go fully solid.

dos: Do put every new control in a Floating Capsule or the Floating Panel over the canvas, anchored to a window corner, the bottom centre, or the element it acts on.
Do keep capsules concentric: 14px outer radius, 4px padding, 10px controls.
Do use Signature Ink only for selection, handles, the active tool, focus, drop targets and the commit action.
Do use the system font at 13px with weight for hierarchy and tabular figures for every changing number.
Do give floating surfaces the float-enter rise (250ms, cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)) and honour reduced motion and reduced transparency.
Do dim paper (brightness 0.92) rather than greying it in dark mode.
donts: Don't add a full-width header bar or dock panels to the window edges; the canvas runs edge to edge.
Don't introduce a second accent colour or use ink for decoration, headings or idle states.
Don't put translucent glass under paragraphs or forms; use the panel material.
Don't use hard or offset shadows, or a fourth shadow plane.
Don't use paper white as a UI surface; white belongs to the page.
Don't show destructive red at rest; it appears on hover of a delete control only.
